mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with a 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE > 5.0% are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and housing starts (HOUST) are falling, it signals a weakening demand for goods and a contraction in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the condition (INDPRO > 103.5 and HOUST < 1300) are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained GDP growth rate above 3.0% year-over-year signals a late-cycle expansion with high inflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods with GDP growth rate > 3.0% (yoy) are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with a 3-month decline in INDPRO are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and falling employment (PAYEMS) signal a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the condition (UNRATE > 4.3 and PAYEMS < 159540) are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with a rising RSAFS (over the past 3 months) are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
